title: Arrive and Survive: Scaling Safe Goal-Conditioned Policy Learning from One-Bit Failure Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.26571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contrastive reinforcement learning (CRL) scales effectively in goal-conditioned tasks by casting policy learning into a self-supervised contrastive objective. However, in a failure-terminated Markov decision process, established CRL considers pre-failure future goals only when constructing positive samples, without accounting for the probability mass removed by failure termination. Our theoretical analysis shows that this omission induces a systematic overestimation bias in goal-reaching values. Consequently, near-failure trajectories provide disproportionately strong supervision of success despite retaining little future occupancy. Unsafe actions can thereby be reinforced through catastrophic failure bootstrapping, leading to failed policy learning and unsustainable goal-reaching behaviours. translated_title: 抵达与生存：从单比特失败信号扩展安全目标条件策略学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26571v1 公告类型：新 摘要：对比强化学习（CRL）通过将策略学习转化为自监督对比目标，在目标条件任务中有效扩展。然而，在失败终止的马尔可夫决策过程中，已建立的CRL在构建正样本时仅考虑失败前的未来目标，而未考虑失败终止所移除的概率质量。我们的理论分析表明，这种遗漏在目标达成值中引入了系统性的高估偏差。因此，接近失败的轨迹尽管保留很少的未来占用，却提供了不成比例的强烈成功监督。不安全的动作可能通过灾难性失败引导得到强化，导致策略学习失败和不可持续的目标达成行为。为解决此问题，我们引入了两个最小但强大的修正：质量加权InfoNCE纠正了短生存未来的过度加权。
tldr: 本文提出两种最小修正（质量加权InfoNCE等）以纠正对比强化学习中因忽略失败终止概率质量而导致的高估偏差，从而确保目标条件策略学习的安全性与可持续性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two minimal corrections (e.g., mass-weighted InfoNCE) to address the overestimation bias in contrastive RL caused by ignoring probability mass removed by failure termination, ensuring safe and sustainable goal-conditioned policy learning.
